one_liner.zh: 本周加密与传统同向 risk-off：BTC 窗口约 -4.4% 落入偏震荡，杠杆中性未起哄；中等实现波动上期权相对 RV 仍偏贵，美现货 BTC ETF 温和流出约 -4.63 亿美金，现货成交额同步回落。
one_liner.en: Crypto and TradFi moved in risk-off sync: BTC window ~-4.4% in chop, leverage neutral; mid realized vol with options still rich vs RV; US spot BTC ETFs mild outflow ~-462.70M, spot turnover easing in parallel.

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 -4.63 亿美金

risk.zh: IV-RV 溢价仍厚、VIX 抬升与美债收益率上行并存，若 risk-off 延续，震荡中的流动性与拥挤度需并排看，而非单看点位；杠杆读法：盯拥挤线（费率路径+OI）与出清线（2026-09-11 峰是否双高、次日是否退烧）。
risk.en: Thick IV-RV premium alongside higher VIX and rising UST yields; if risk-off persists, watch liquidity and crowding inside the chop rather than level alone; Leverage read: crowding (funding path+OI) and flush (2026-09-11 peak dual-high? next-day cool-down?).

watch.zh: 盯 ETF 温和流出是否延续、资金费率年化路径与 OI 是否仍中性，以及 IV 相对 RV 溢价会否收窄。
watch.en: Watch whether mild ETF outflow persists, if funding ann. path and OI stay neutral, and whether IV richness vs RV narrows.

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏贵（IV 相对 RV 溢价）

compare.zh: BTC 窗口约 -4.4%，明显深于 ETH 约 -1.5%；美股 ES/NQ 仅小幅回撤，黄金亦弱，VIX 明显抬升，整体更像风险偏好同步降温而非加密独跌。
compare.en: BTC window ~-4.4% ran deeper than ETH ~-1.5%; ES/NQ only mild pullbacks, gold soft, VIX up sharply—more synchronized risk-off than crypto-only weakness.

path.zh: 路径标签偏震荡：周内并未走出单边趋势延续，更多是在 risk-off 背景下的来回消化；相对上周由正收益翻为负，节奏从偏强切到整理。
path.en: Path labeled chop: no clean trend extension, more two-way digestion under risk-off; flipped from prior-week gain to loss, tempo shifting from firmer to range.

leverage.zh:
标签：杠杆中性。
① 拥挤线（OI + 资金费率年化）：周初约 +3.16%/yr → 期末约 +7.84%/yr，租金全周抬升；OI 周变约 -0.61%（105565 → 104917），全周库存仅略变——更像摩擦周，而非匀速大拆/大堆杠杆。
② 出清线（OI + 清算）：主峰日 09-11（2026-09-11）；峰值约 1.75× 周内中位清算量；价格同日约 +0.9%；当日 OI 约 103405；但 OI 周高在 2026-09-07（约 106894），峰值日并非双高；峰值日 OI 较前一日下降，偏出清/去库存与清算同日。次日 2026-09-12：OI 自峰值日回落至约 103322、funding 年化约 +5.25%/yr、价格约 +0.1%。
③ 量旁证（永续成交额=活跃度）：周合计约 652.65 亿美金，WoW 约 -14.4%，活跃度中性；量侧用于核对热闹程度，不拆多空。
收句：拥挤线与出清线并读 → 清算峰相对中位偏温和、峰值日并非 OI 周高（无「清算∥OI 双高」）、费率租金上升但 OI 库存不增、量旁证偏淡，共同支撑「杠杆中性」；禁止把清算/OI/funding 写成涨跌原因。
leverage.en:
Label: leverage_neutral.
① Crowding (OI + funding ann.): ~+3.16%/yr → ~+7.84%/yr — rent rose over the week; OI week change ~-0.61% (105565 → 104917), inventory barely moved — friction week, not steady build/unwind.
② Flush (OI + liquidations): peak day 2026-09-11; peak ~1.75× median liq qty; price that day ~+0.9%; OI that day ~103405; OI week-high was 2026-09-07 (~106894), not a dual-high peak day; OI down vs prior day — flush/de-stocking with liquidations. Next day 2026-09-12: OI eased to ~103322; funding ~+5.25%/yr; price ~+0.1%.
③ Volume side (perp turnover = activity): week sum ~65.26B, WoW ~-14.4%, activity normal; activity only, not long/short.
Close: crowding + flush lines → liq peak mild vs median; peak day ≠ OI week-high (no liq∥OI dual-high); funding rent up but OI inventory not building; volume side quieter — supports “leverage_neutral”; do not write liq/OI/funding as the cause of price.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎约 -4.63 亿美金，通道温和流出（0 流入日 / 4 流出日，单日最深约在 9/10）；ETH ETF 净流入约 +1.97 亿美金形成对照。Binance 现货成交额周合计约 73.41 亿美金、环比约 -6.6%，与净流并陈只作通道冷暖，不解释涨跌。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETFs combined net ~-462.70M, mild outflow (0 inflow / 4 outflow days; deepest day ~9/10); ETH ETFs net ~+196.90M as contrast. Binance spot turnover week sum ~7.34B (~-6.6% wow), shown beside flows as channel temperature only—not price causation.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 73.41 亿美金，相对上完整周 -6.6%（活跃度「中性」；上周约 78.60 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-09-11（15.29 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 652.65 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 7.34B, vs prior full week -6.6% (activity “normal”; prior ~7.86B). Peak day 2026-09-11 (1.53B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (65.26B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 中等 RV 配上仍厚的 IV 溢价，意味着期权定价仍在为尾部或事件付费，而现货路径本身并未释放同等振幅；ETH 的 IV/RV 结构同样偏贵但水平更高。
vol_teach.en: Mid RV with still-thick IV premium means options still price tails/events while spot path did not deliver matching amplitude; ETH IV/RV likewise rich at higher levels.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 19.7% 落在中等带，期末 Deribit IV 约 38.9%，IV-RV 点差约 19.2 个百分点，期权相对实现波动偏贵标签成立。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~19.7% ann. in mid band; end Deribit IV ~38.9%, IV-RV spread ~19.2 pts—options rich vs realized holds.

vol_combo.zh: 波动组合像「实现中等、隐含偏贵」：既非死寂也非恐慌尖刺，适合把溢价本身当作观察对象，而不是把本周振幅说成极端。
vol_combo.en: Vol combo reads mid realized + rich implied: neither dead calm nor panic spike; treat the premium as the object to watch rather than calling this week’s amplitude extreme.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格周跌与 IV 绝对水平仍高并存：下跌并未立刻把隐含波动压回实现波动附近，溢价收窄与否仍是下一窗的变量。
vol_price_iv.en: Weekly price drop coexisted with still-elevated IV: the decline did not immediately crush implied back toward realized; whether the premium narrows remains a next-window variable.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 窗口约 +9.0%，与加密侧 IV 偏贵、传统 risk-off 同向；美债 10Y 约 +16.9 bp、美元几乎走平，风险资产普偏承压的宏观底色一致。
vol_vix.en: VIX window ~+9.0%, aligned with crypto IV richness and TradFi risk-off; UST 10Y ~+16.9 bp, DXY nearly flat—consistent macro backdrop of broad risk pressure.

what.zh: 美股隐含波动指数 VIX

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元略弱可作弱背景，不是主引擎。
vs_crypto.en: Mild USD softness is backdrop, not the main engine.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与 BTC 同向可兼容，但是不同资产逻辑。
vs_crypto.en: Same direction as BTC is compatible; drivers still differ.

tradfi_summary.zh: 传统括号内 ES 约 -0.8%、NQ 约 -0.5%，黄金约 -1.5%，VIX 上行、美债收益率上行，与 BTC 更深回撤构成同向 risk-off，而非股强币弱的背离周。
tradfi_summary.en: TradFi bracket: ES ~-0.8%, NQ ~-0.5%, gold ~-1.5%, VIX up and yields up—same-direction risk-off with BTC’s deeper pullback, not a stocks-strong/crypto-weak decoupling week.

three_conclusions.zh: 加密与美股/VIX 同向 risk-off，BTC 回撤深于宽基，但是杠杆保持中性、OI 略降，并非杠杆推动的单边踩踏叙事。
three_conclusions.en: Crypto and equities/VIX in risk-off sync; BTC fell harder than beta, yet leverage stayed neutral with OI slightly down—not a leverage-driven stampede story.

three_conclusions.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 温和流出约 -4.63 亿美金，与现货成交额约 73.41 亿美金、环比回落并陈，通道偏冷但未到强流出量级。
three_conclusions.en: US spot BTC ETF mild outflow ~-462.70M beside spot turnover ~7.34B (easing wow): channel cooler, not yet strong-outflow scale.

three_conclusions.zh: 中等 RV 上 IV 仍显著溢价，期权偏贵与震荡路径并存，下一窗关键在于溢价是否收敛、以及流出姿态会否翻转向。
three_conclusions.en: Mid RV with still-significant IV premium: richness coexists with chop; next window hinges on whether premium compresses and outflow stance flips.

text.zh: BTC 美现货 ETF 净流是否继续温和流出，或出现单日/累计翻转向流入。
text.en: Whether BTC US spot ETF net stays in mild outflow or flips toward inflow on a day or cumulative basis.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周由上周强流入转为温和流出，通道姿态是本周与上周最大反差之一，适合作为下期核对哨。

text.zh: Deribit BTC IV-RV 点差是否仍维持双位数溢价，或向实现波动收敛。
text.en: Whether Deribit BTC IV-RV spread stays in double-digit richness or converges toward realized.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 期末溢价约 19 pt 且标签为期权偏贵，是波动结构的核心矛盾，收窄与否改变叙事重心。

text.zh: 资金费率年化与 OI 周变是否仍停留在杠杆中性带，清算是否再现峰值日。
text.en: Whether funding ann. and OI wow remain in leverage-neutral band and if another liquidation peak day reappears.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周中性 + 小幅 OI 降 + 单日清算峰，需验证拥挤与出清是否升级，避免与价格涨跌焊死。

matched.zh: 匹配均值回归与波动收割：标签为偏震荡 + 杠杆中性 + IV 相对 RV 偏贵，路径缺乏顺势延伸，溢价与来回结构比单边趋势更合拍。
matched.en: Matched mean-reversion and vol-harvest: chop + leverage-neutral + IV rich vs RV favors two-way structure and premium over one-way trend extension.

mismatched.zh: 趋势跟踪不匹配：本周偏震荡且与传统同向降温，缺少可持续的方向动量标签。
mismatched.en: Trend-following mismatched: chop under synchronized cooling lacks durable directional momentum.
